premiumPreview.summary: Design reviewable AI proposals that expose evidence and uncertainty before a user confirms a versioned product action.
learningOutcomes: Separate generated proposals, local review state, explicit user decisions, and authoritative outcomes.
Change available actions when evidence is stale, incomplete, or permission-restricted.
Reconcile mixed per-item results without turning optimistic state into false success.
Keep cancellation, provenance, safe rendering, feedback, and accessible status behavior explicit.
premiumPreview.unlockDescription: Premium unlocks the destructive-edit example, proposal freshness, capability checks, and mixed-outcome recovery.
